translation:
Well who cares about that. More importantly,
I've figured out something incredible!
You're way too loud. Keep it down.

I just can't be quiet! I've uncovered the
truth of this mystery!
The key to the truth… is this!

Full of confidence, Haruhi pointed to the class
1-6 plate.

What about that scrap of wood is the key
exactly?

Despite knowing, I did my best to feign
ignorance. It's all part of the act.

Well, at your level it would certainly be
impossible to figure it out.

An annoying remark, but I'm not about to put
everything we've done to waste.

I'll just respectfully listen to the deductions
of renowned ultra detective Haruhi Suzumiya.

You listening? The answer is elementary: it
was all a trick.

The key lies with the structure of this building
we call our school.

It goes without saying, but the classrooms
are all the same shape, aren't they?
I guess.

If we were to be specific, parts of them might
be slightly different…

But it's safe to say their structure is nearly
identical.

For example… Hmm, what about your classroom
Mikuru? Same as the first-years', right?
Umm, yes. I think it's the same.
And Yuki's classroom?

The structure is similar. The furnishings are
also approximately equal.

In other words—no matter what year or
classroom, there's no big difference.

I get that the structure is the same, but just
what are you saying that means?

Don't ruin my explanation! I'm still just laying
the groundwork!
Sure sure. That was my bad.

Ultimately, the only way you can tell which
class corresponds to which classroom, is this.

If you flip that on its head, just by
exchanging the plates…
…even class 6 can become class 10!
I see… So that's what was going on.

Koizumi nodded with admiration so theatrically
that you couldn't even tell he was acting.
You already get it, Koizumi?
This is purely my personal conjecture, but…
I wonder if perhaps the plates were swapped?

Ding ding ding! You're absolutely right! That's
why you're the deputy brigade chief, Koizumi!
I'm honored to receive your praise.

You've got some nerve considering you're the
guy that did it.

Though, I should prompt her with a question
so she clarifies her reasoning a bit more.

It seems like Haruhi hasn't figured out the
trick to how this works yet…

Let's assume you're right about the plates
being exchanged—
What do you mean assume? That's—
Let me finish.

Why do you think that classroom is class 10?
There's no plate with 10 on it.

That's a pretty good question coming from
you, Kyon.
I'll give it to you straight.
Looks like I don't even need to ask.

What would you think if class 9's plate was in
place of class 8's?
I guess I'd think it was class 9.

And beyond that, if there was no plate where
class 9 should be?
You'd think it's class 10, right?
Well… I guess so.

Exactly! The plates were offset by one! I've
discovered the truth!

Umm… But, for what reason would someone do
such a thing?
Nice backup, Asahina.

It's got to be someone's prank. Not many
people come to school over summer vacation…

Maybe they were trying to confuse someone
who comes here for club activities.

Then one of the members of the computer
society got fantastically fooled.
What a complete idiot.

Thanks to that, I believed there was a
man-eating classroom.

And thanks to that, I worked to the bone to
make you change your mind.
All I can say is what an anticlimax.
About Haruhi
